# Playing a turn {#sec-turn}

Turns go clockwise around the table. On your turn you have **3 actions**,
which you can spend in any order.

## Actions {#sec-actions}

| Action               | Cost      | Rules                  |
|----------------------|-----------|------------------------|
| Move a piece         | 1 action  | @sec-moving            |
| Split a piece        | 1 action  | @sec-superposition     |
| Entangle two pieces  | 2 actions | @sec-entanglement      |
| Measure a piece      | 1 action  | @sec-measurement       |

## Moving {#sec-moving}

A piece moves one square in any direction, including diagonally.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Tip
Save an action for a measurement at the end of your turn. It can stop an
opponent's plan before it starts.
:::
